notes: Retrospective finding of SP-uwkr7iyl close, 2026-10-10. Recurred in SP-ilje65fa (2026-10-10): a dispatch piped into cut ran in the foreground, was moved to the background with a 10-minute cap and was killed and restarted; a background dispatch with timeout 7200000 also shares the Bash task's process group, so a worker running past two hours would be killed with it: the orchestrator started later dispatches detached (start_new_session) and waited on the pid. Merged at the 2026-10-12 draft triage: ST-tlqcchsu (kb-sprint review step 4 names --repro but not --repro-reason or story parking for a gap with no repro command; same SP-uwkr7iyl close, same two files). Planned 2026-10-12: the run step of skills/sprint/SKILL.md already says to start dispatch with run_in_background and timeout 7200000 ms; it names no detached start (start_new_session), no log outside _cache/, and the review step names no --repro-reason.
